name: Hero 2 (stocky knight)
description: a stocky, broad-shouldered veteran knight, a little shorter than average with a thick torso, short sturdy legs and big gauntleted hands; full plate armour of polished dark steel with a strong metallic sheen: bright, crisp specular highlights and reflected rim light along every plate edge; the armour is battle-worn: a few dents, worn bright edges where the dark finish has rubbed off, some patches of rust-brown at the joints and the lower greaves; a rounded dome great helm with a single horizontal visor slit and a raised central ridge, no face visible; rounded pauldrons, a barrel-shaped breastplate, plate gauntlets, greaves and broad sabatons; a wide red-brown leather belt with a dark iron buckle; a dark-grey chainmail skirt to mid-thigh; a full-length deep crimson wool cape fastened at both shoulders, hanging in a few heavy folds down to the calves, faded and mud-stained toward the bottom with a frayed, slightly torn hem; both hands empty, no weapon, no shield
